name: Sho Reilen
source: A crazed, villainous, cheerful child with no conscience – quite a despicable person and seeks pleasure in ruining others. With a terrible personality like that, she certainly has made herself a lot of enemies, but then again, it’s hard to tell what she wants, or what she is thinking.
